description: A utility class for monetary calculations, specifically handling rounding modes and MathContext caching per tenant in a multi-tenant environment. The class is independent of Spring and focuses on rounding configuration management.

classes.name: MoneyHelper
classes.description: A final utility class that provides static methods for managing tenant-specific rounding modes and MathContext objects for financial calculations.

methods.name: initializeTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Sets up the rounding mode for a specific tenant during application startup.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current tenant's rounding mode based on the tenant context.

methods.name: getMathContext
methods.description: Provides the MathContext configured for the current tenant, including precision and rounding mode.

methods.name: updateTenantRoundingMode
methods.description: Updates the rounding mode for a given tenant, typically on configuration change.

methods.name: createMathContext
methods.description: Creates a MathContext with a specified RoundingMode, independent of tenant context.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears all cached rounding modes and MathContexts for all tenants, useful during shutdown or reset.

methods.name: clearCacheForTenant
methods.description: Clears cached data for a specific tenant, such as when a tenant is removed or reconfigured.

methods.name: getInitializedTenants
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of all tenants that have been initialized with specific rounding modes.

methods.name: isTenantInitialized
methods.description: Checks whether a particular tenant has been initialized with a rounding mode.

methods.name: getTenantIdentifier
methods.description: Private method retrieving the current tenant's identifier from thread-local context.

methods.name: validateAndConvertRoundingMode
methods.description: Validates an integer rounding mode value and converts it to a RoundingMode enum.
